items.label: Ultimate UPF 50+ UV Protection
items.value: Crafted from UPF 50+ sun protection fabric, this hooded long-sleeve shirt blocks over 98% of UVA/UVB rays, providing reliable sun protection for your skin while outdoors

items.label: Lightweight & Quick Dry
items.value: Featuring advanced moisture-wicking technology, the lightweight fabric pulls sweat away from your skin to the surface for quick evaporation; This ensures you stay cool and dry even during the hot summer or outdoor activities

items.label: Crossover Hood & Thumb Holes
items.value: Designed with a crossover neck hoodie and low-profile thumb holes, this shirt delivers full coverage for your neck and hands; The thumb holes keep sleeves in place for extra sun protection, while the ergonomic hood stays secure during movement or wind

items.label: Athletic Fit with Raglan Sleeves
items.value: The raglan sleeve construction combined with flatlock seams minimizes friction and allows for a full range of motion; Combined with a tagless collar, it eliminates skin irritation for a seamless, comfortable fit

items.label: Occasions
items.value: Built with 4-way stretch fabric for unrestricted movement and integrated with high-visibility reflective strips on the sleeves, it is perfect for fishing, hiking, swimming, boating, running, cycling, workouts, or just relaxing at the beach
